description: This source file contains unit tests for WebSocket stream handling, focusing on cookie management (both client-side cookies and server-set cookies) within the Chromium networking code. It defines test classes, parameters, and test cases for cookie behavior over WebSocket connections, including secure and domain-sharing scenarios.

classes.name: TestBase
classes.description: Base class for WebSocket stream tests, providing a method to create and connect WebSocket streams with cookie expectations.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamClientUseCookieTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying client-side cookie handling in WebSocket connections.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamServerSetCookieTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying server-set cookie handling in WebSocket connections.

methods.name: CreateAndConnect
methods.description: Creates and connects a WebSocket stream with specified URL, origin, site for cookies, isolation info, cookie headers, and response body.

methods.name: SetCookieHelperFunction
methods.description: Helper callback to set cookie asynchronously and post a task upon completion.

methods.name: GetCookieListHelperFunction
methods.description: Helper callback to retrieve cookie list asynchronously and post a task upon completion.
